source.title: Khaz'gorite rank crosscheck and Dragonflight numeric source triage

notes: No NEW original completed-prospect or mill operation cohort with exact input/output rank, per-output castsWithDrop or 0-N histograms found. Original Bugy/Jallfo/Xenastro/ar_rules/Aary/TheChisel/superbondez and 8000-cast Serevite data already held; no duplicate rows added. Weak new identity crosscheck: separate GoldCap and WoW Price Hub market pages agree Khaz'gorite Ore 190312 rank1, 190313 rank2, 190314 rank3, but both are secondary and not game-client/Blizzard tooltip proof; do not promote to officially verified. Original source 1000 R2 Khaz refined ->22 Awakened Order was noted but is REFINING rather than targeted Prospect/Mill/Disenchant/Smelt, so not misfiled as measured processing. Tooltips inaccessible; Firecrawl credits exhausted. Unknown completed casts/refunds, occurrence denominators, stack histograms, patch/build and Serevite official rank mapping remain null; do not calculate chance, confidence or gold.
